sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default value when something is Nothing
sketches.resonance: When you reach for someone and find Nothing, you fall back on yourself — fromMaybe is the quiet resilience of having a default.
sketches.draft:
module Grief where

import Data.Maybe

you :: Maybe a
you = Nothing

carryOn :: a -> a
carryOn self = fromMaybe self you

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sending on a channel that no one receives from blocks forever, and select{} blocks forever explicitly
sketches.resonance: A message sent into a channel no one listens to is a voice that waits forever — the goroutine never terminates, never errs, just quietly hangs.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with a single method that returns itself, creating infinite self-reference through the type system
sketches.resonance: Longing is a promise that, once fulfilled, only produces more of itself — each call resolves into another identical call.
